title: Physician Assistant / Nurse Practitioner Telehealth
description:
This is a remote position.

Compensation: $110,000-$158,000/year · Full-time · 100% Remote · California license required What you'll do

• Conduct telehealth consultations with new and returning patients (typically 16-20 per day), with adequate time and clinical support for each visit.

• Assess and manage weight-related conditions and comorbidities through a primary care lens.

• Provide evidence-based guidance on weight loss medications (including GLP-1s such as Ozempic, Wegovy, and Mounjaro) and lifestyle strategies.

• Respond to patient messages in our care platform regarding treatment plans and progress.

• Build strong, compassionate rapport with patients living with overweight or obesity.

• Maintain full HIPAA compliance across all communications and records.

• Stay current on best practices in obesity medicine, chronic disease, and primary care.

Requirements

• Active California NP or PA license (required - additional licensure in TX, FL, or NY is a strong plus).

• NP (ANCC/AANP certified) or PA (NCCPA certified) with 2+ years of post-graduate clinical experience.

• Primary care background.

• 6+ months supporting weight management patients, including prescribing/managing injectable medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro) preferred. Experience with compounded weight loss medications is a plus.

• Comfortable with telemedicine platforms, EHRs, and clinical documentation tools.

• Strong communication skills and an empathetic, patient-centered manner.

• Self-starter genuinely passionate about helping patients reach their health goals.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional remote work environment.

• Must pass a background check and be eligible for Medicare enrollment.

Benefits

• Competitive salary ($110,000-$158,000, based on experience and multi-state licensure)

• Malpractice insurance and licensure coverage

• CME allowance

• Silver PPO health insurance,

• HSA

• 401(k)

• Paid time off

• 7 paid holidays

• Flexible schedule and a collaborating physician provided

title: Staff / Principal Research Engineer, AI Safety Mitigations
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; London, UK; San Francisco, CA USA
description:

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

At Lila Sciences, you will develop and test safeguards that reduce societal risks from increasingly capable closed loop scientific AI. This is a high-priority individual contributor role for an engineer who has built safety interventions within the development and deployment of frontier models and wants to apply that experience to scientific models, agents, tools and laboratory-connected workflows.

You will work with domain scientists, risk researchers, evaluators and engineering teams to turn risk findings and policy requirements into effective interventions. The work spans research and implementation: developing approaches, testing their limits and helping integrate reliable safeguards into the systems where they are needed. We are open to different levels of seniority and depth across mitigation approaches.

What You'll Be Building

• Translate scientific risk assessments, dual-use policy boundaries and evaluation findings into concrete mitigation designs and testable requirements.

• Develop and implement safeguards suited to the problem, potentially spanning model training, classifiers, monitoring, access controls and runtime interventions.

• Build experiments that measure risk reduction, robustness and effects on legitimate scientific use, alongside practical performance constraints.

• Use adversarial findings and observed failures to improve safeguards, working closely with automated-safety and scientific evaluation researchers.

• Work directly with model-training, post-training, inference and platform teams to integrate mitigations into model development, release evaluation and large-scale serving systems, with appropriate instrumentation and reproducible testing.

• Investigate regressions, distribution shifts and emerging misuse patterns, and use the evidence to guide further development.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Hands-on experience developing and validating safety interventions for frontier models within training, post-training or large-scale inference systems, with contributions to model development or release cycles.

• Depth in at least one relevant area, such as safety post-training, model-level classifiers, safeguards integrated into inference, or abuse monitoring and enforcement across a model-serving platform.

• Experience working directly with model-development or safeguards teams, using access appropriate to the intervention-such as training pipelines, model internals, inference infrastructure or systematic evaluation access-to investigate failures and implement improvements.

• Strong research-engineering skills and the ability to move from an ambiguous problem to working, maintainable implementations.

• Sound experimental judgment, including an ability to assess robustness, interpret imperfect metrics and reason about competing objectives.

• The ability to collaborate across research and engineering teams, explain technical trade-offs and take ownership of complex individual contributions.

• Experience with scientific models, scientific software or laboratory-connected systems.

• Safety work involving tool-using agents, multi-step workflows or high-consequence misuse.

Frontend Engineer (Mid-Level)
Who is Parser ?
Technology alone does not create impact-the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.
We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), the Americas (US, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia), and the Middle East. We combine global reach with a mindset focused on agility, senior expertise, and close collaboration.
We work as an extension of our clients’ teams, helping them define the right problems, shape solutions, and deliver technology-driven outcomes that create measurable business value. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.
Why Join Us?
If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.
How will you impact?
As a Mid-Level Frontend Engineer, you will own consumer-facing web features end-to-end within a microfrontend ecosystem. Your work directly drives organic acquisition and user experience through web performance optimizations, seamless right-to-left localization, and reliable product delivery.
Your key responsibilities:
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

• Build and ship responsive, mobile-first user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Next.js across server- and client-rendered applications.

• Develop reusable design system components supporting multi-country configuration, internationalisation, and right-to-left (RTL) Arabic layouts.

• Optimize web performance and Core Web Vitals, including bundle size, hydration costs, rendering paths, image/font loading, and caching strategies.

• Maintain robust application contracts and shared libraries across microfrontend architectures.

• Implement reliable analytics tracking, feature flags, and unit, component, and end-to-end testing (using Playwright and Storybook).

• Utilize production signals, real-user monitoring, and error tracking tools to proactively resolve performance and user-facing issues.

• Collaborate closely with product, design, SEO, and backend teams, delivering thoughtful code reviews and engineering improvements.

What you’ll bring to the role:
Essential Requirements:

• 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience delivering and operating production web applications.

• Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern state/data-fetching patterns.

• Hands-on experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG, routing, server vs. client-side execution).

• Solid foundation in semantic HTML, CSS Modules/responsive layout systems, and web accessibility fundamentals.

• Practical experience with API integration, unit/component testing, and automated E2E testing (Playwright preferred).

• Proven understanding of Core Web Vitals, web performance measurement, and debugging techniques.

Desirable Requirements:

• Experience with microfrontend architectures, monorepos, or shared npm packages.

• Hands-on experience with internationalisation (i18n), right-to-left (RTL) layouts, and SEO-driven products.

• Exposure to frontend observability, tag management, feature flagging, or geospatial/maps APIs.

Location:
Spain (Remote) Candidates must be able to accommodate UAE working hours.
You will receive:

• The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.

• The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.

• A highly competitive compensation package.

• A flexible and hybrid working environment.

• Medical insurance.

College Board ’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement examinations, working closely with partners across College Board , the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. The Resolve team serves as trusted experts in post-administration issue resolution for SAT and AP assessments, ensuring issues reported by educators and students are resolved efficiently, protecting the integrity of our assessments and the validity of student scores.

• Drive adoption of automation and AI tools that measurably improve processing speed and accuracy

• Translate case trends and root causes into upstream fixes that prevent issues before test day

Lead and Manage the Resolve Team (25%)

title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Verstehe, wie Menschen arbeiten. Bau die Software, die ihre Arbeit besser macht.

Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Wir können direkt beobachten, wo Prozesse haken, welche Informationen fehlen und was Menschen unnötig Zeit kostet.

Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen.

WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST

- Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen: Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen.

- Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen: Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen.

- Die Roadmap gestalten: Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich.

- Lösungen entwickeln: Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.

- Zusammenhänge durchdringen: Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind - und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben.

- Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt.

- KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe: Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss.

- Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten: Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss.

- Gutes Produkturteil: Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe.

- Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme: Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen.

- Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz: Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus.

- Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit: Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung.

- Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise: Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran.

Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein - wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe.

WARUM DU BEI BUENA EINSTEIGEN SOLLTEST

- Du bist nah am Problem: Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert.

- Du gestaltest das Produkt mit: In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

- Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag: Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung.

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team: Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 50

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
Position: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.
The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.
Key Responsibilities
1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership
Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.
Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.
Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.
Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.
Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.
2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance
Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.
Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.
Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.
Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.
3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.
Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.
Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.
Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.
4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management
Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.
Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.
Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.
Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.
Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.
5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management
Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.
Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.
Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

About the role

We are looking for a Director of Revenue Operations to own the planning, forecasting, and operational infrastructure behind our Success organization. Working directly with our Revenue Operations leader and closely with Success leadership, you will turn company priorities into goals, compensation plans, and practical ways of working. What we are looking for:

• 7+ years in RevOps, CS Ops, or BizOps, with real ownership of post-sale performance

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). • Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• 401K

• Supplies and other perks

• Malpractice coverage

Overview

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
As Certara continues to grow, our Finance organization plays a critical role in translating that growth into clear, accurate, and timely information - both for the leaders who run the business day to day and for the investors and regulators who rely on our public filings. We're looking for a Manager, Financial Reporting who can move comfortably between both worlds: building the internal management reporting that helps leadership make decisions, and preparing the external SEC reporting that keeps us compliant, transparent, and audit-ready.
Position Summary
This is a dual-mandate role. You'll split your time between the mechanics of quarterly and annual SEC filings and the ongoing rhythm of internal management reporting - supporting board and executive decks, monthly financial packages, and KPI reporting used across the business. You'll work closely with Accounting, FP&A, SEC reporting, and the Business Unit finance leaders, and you'll be a key contributor to how Certara tells its financial story, internally and externally.

• Support the external audit process, including responding to auditor requests and resolving open items

Internal Management Reporting

• Develop and maintain recurring KPI and BU reporting used by business unit and corporate leadership

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes, including consolidation and reporting tools

• Serve as a liaison between the accounting close process and the business, ensuring management reporting reconciles cleanly to the general ledger and external filings

Cross-Functional & Process

• Help maintain internal controls (SOX) relevant to the financial close and reporting cycle

• Support ad hoc projects such as acquisition integration reporting, new accounting standard implementation, and process improvement initiatives

• Act as a point of contact across Accounting, FP&A, and SEC Reporting to keep internal and external reporting consistent

• 5-8 years of progressive experience in accounting or financial reporting, with meaningful exposure to SEC reporting (public company or Big 4/public accounting background preferred)

• Working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting requirements; exposure to XBRL a

title: Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Position Title: Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer
Location: Remote (In the U.S)
Other Considerations: U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)
Position is contingent on contract award
POSITION SUMMARY
Sprezzatura is seeking a Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer to support cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VA.gov Platform.
The Security Automation / Data Engineer will design, develop, and implement automation that improves how security compliance data is collected, assessed, measured, and reported across a large-scale digital platform. This role will help transform repeatable, manual security and compliance activities into sustainable, engineering-driven capabilities that provide greater visibility into security posture and reduce the operational burden associated with maintaining compliance.
Working alongside security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, this position will focus on automated evidence collection and controls assessment, security data integration, compliance measurement, vulnerability and remediation reporting, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) capabilities, and security posture dashboards.
The ideal candidate combines cybersecurity knowledge with strong automation and data engineering skills and is comfortable integrating information across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tools, APIs, and compliance systems.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, develop, and maintain automated processes for collecting security and compliance evidence from authoritative system, infrastructure, configuration, and security data sources

• Develop automation to support security control assessment and continuous monitoring, including OSCAL-based evidence collection and control-assessment capabilities

• Build integrations and data pipelines that aggregate and normalize security information from multiple tools, platforms, and APIs

• Develop security metrics and dashboards that provide near-real-time visibility into control posture, remediation status, vulnerabilities, and other security indicators

• Automate recurring security and compliance reporting for security teams, engineering teams, program leadership, and government stakeholders

• Develop capabilities for measuring security-control and security-tooling coverage across applications, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines

• Automate vulnerability and remediation reporting to support prioritization, ownership, aging analysis, and tracking through closure

• Support implementation and operation of an SBOM capability, including collection and analysis of software dependency and third-party component data

• Integrate SBOM and software supply-chain information with vulnerability management and security reporting capabilities

• Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to ensure security controls implemented within CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure generate usable, repeatable compliance evidence

• Identify manual security and compliance processes that are candidates for automation and implement scalable solutions where feasible

• Support the development of repeatable processes that enable product and engineering teams to demonstrate continued compliance with defined security standards

• Ensure automated security evidence, metrics, and reporting are traceable, maintainable, and usable during ongoing compliance activities and independent controls assessments

• Document automation, integrations, data sources, processes, and technical solutions to support long-term sustainment by the Platform Security team

• Collaborate with security engineers, cybersecurity/RMF specialists, DevSecOps engineers, software engineers, product teams, and government stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate's degree and four (4) years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant experience.

• Five (5) years of experience as a Cyber Security Engineer may be substituted in lieu of a degree

description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

Salary
 
The salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,000/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an FP&A Senior Expert to lead financial planning and analysis for the businesses Nubank is building beyond its core Latin American markets. Today that means Nu US and Nu Global. You will be the finance owner for these businesses and for new geographies from the first business case through launch: building their P&Ls, standing up planning and forecasting, and giving leadership a clear, independent view of whether each business is on track.

This role is not about maintaining an established forecast. New businesses start with little operating history, product plans that are still taking shape, and legal and regulatory structures that are still being defined. You will build the financial model of a business before it has data, decide which assumptions matter most, and revise them as the business learns. The scope covers every product we offer in these markets, including credit card, lending, banking, and international money movement.

The role is designed to move with Nubank's expansion. As a business matures, its FP&A transitions into a permanent structure and you take on the next new market. You will also lead the financial analysis behind opportunities the company is evaluating, so you will be part of the conversation about where Nubank goes next.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and consistent exposure to senior leadership, including the executives who run these businesses. You will be expected to hold a position when the analysis supports it, push back with evidence, and take direct feedback.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will be the technical lead for a small team of up to three analysts, setting the standard for their work and developing them while staying hands-on in the models and analysis yourself.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Own the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles for Nu US and Nu Global, with full accountability for the integrity of the numbers and for the position Finance takes on them with leadership.

- Build financial services P&Ls from first principles across credit, banking, and payments products, and model how product, pricing, and funding decisions flow through to each business's results and to Nubank's consolidated P&L.

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SDR Manager to lead our growing SDR team. This individual will be responsible for managing and scaling our outbound pipeline generation efforts while coaching and developing a high-performing team of SDRs.

This is a high-impact role that will sit at the center of our go-to-market motion. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to refine our outbound strategy, improve conversion rates, and ensure the SDR team consistently generates qualified pipeline as we continue expanding our presence.

This role requires 3 days in our NYC office

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on. You will:

- Manage, coach, and develop a global team of SDRs responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline

- Build and optimize outbound prospecting strategies across target accounts, regions and verticals, including signal-based programs driven by market events and 9fin content

- Partner closely with AEs to create targeted outbound campaigns and define the SDR-to-AE handoff, including qualification standards (MEDDPICC-aligned), SLAs and meeting quality feedback

- Work closely with Marketing, ABM and Demand Generation to plan and execute campaigns (content, events, webinars, and market-driven outreach)

- Develop and refine SDR playbooks, messaging frameworks, and outreach cadences, and test what works by region

- Design and scale AI-enabled prospecting and account research workflows (Claude, ChatGPT, Clay) across the team

- Manage account tiering, territory and coverage models

- Monitor and improve key SDR performance metrics including activity levels, meeting conversion rates, and pipeline generated, and work with RevOps to build reporting, forecasting, and performance dashboards

- Own SDR hiring, onboarding and ramp

- Build in-role career development plans and milestones for SDRs, with clear paths into AE and other GTM roles

- Support SDR career development through training, Gong call reviews, role-plays, and regular coaching

- Evaluate and manage the external tech tools used across Sales and Marketing teams (Clay, Gong Engage, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), and stay up to date with the key dynamics shaping the global Leveraged Finance, Private Credit, and Structured Finance markets

ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you have:

- Prior experience managing SDR/BDR team(s) or leading sales development functions, ideally 2+ years management experience, including distributed or multi-region teams

- 4+ years of experience in sales development, pipeline generation, or related go-to-market roles

- Strong experience with outbound prospecting strategies and pipeline generation, including ABM-aligned and signal-based outbound

- Experience working with Salesforce (or other CRM systems), Gong (Engage or other sales engagement platforms), Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Hubspot, lead generation platforms, and Excel/G Suite

- AI fluency, with hands-on experience using Claude, ChatGPT or similar

title: Key Account Executive -Gurugram (Contractual)
description:

This is a field-heavy, high-ownership role. You will source and sign new rest stops on active and upcoming corridors, negotiate fixed-fee and revenue-share deals, keep collections and compliance on track, and develop new ways to create value from FlixBus's daily passenger touchpoints. You will report to the Regional Operations Manager and present performance, risks and opportunities to senior leadership.

About the Role

• Identify, evaluate and onboard new highway rest stops on active and upcoming FlixBus corridors, conducting site visits to assess hygiene, footfall, accessibility and brand fit.

• Negotiate fixed-fee and revenue-share agreements with rest stop operators that are commercially sound and build long-term, sustainable partnerships.

• Build and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective stops across North India, South India and new geographies as FlixBus scales.

• Own the full onboarding lifecycle - from first contact to signed agreement, system entry and compliance activation.

• Track monthly collections across all active stops, flag shortfalls early and drive recovery, escalating to bus partner POCs where needed.

• Maintain a clear compliance framework with defined metrics, escalation protocols and partner-level accountability.

• Build and update dashboards and reports that give leadership real-time visibility into revenue, compliance health and programme trends, while keeping data across all tracking tools accurate.

• Drive geographic expansion corridor by corridor - mapping opportunities, prioritising by revenue potential and executing the rollout independently, including seasonal, expressway and off-peak transitions.

• Develop new on-ground monetisation opportunities such as onboard branding, co-branded rest areas, FMCG or F&B partnerships and last-mile tie-ups; build business cases, pilot them on a defined corridor and recommend whether to scale or exit.

• Keep a close eye on commercial approaches in the wider mobility and travel industry and bring relevant ideas back into FlixBus’s strategy.

About You

• 2-4 years of experience in business development, commercial partnerships, field operations or programme management - ideally in mobility, logistics, FMCG, hospitality or a start-up environment.

• A Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

• Proven ability to own a commercial relationship end to end: sourcing, negotiating, signing and managing, including closing deals independently with small business owners.

• A structured mindset, with the ability to build frameworks, pipelines and trackers from scratch.

• Comfort working with data: Excel or Google Sheets, basic dashboards and presenting numbers clearly to leadership.

• Excellent communication in Hindi and English for vendor dealings and internal reporting.

• Willingness to travel extensively across Indian highway corridors.

• Familiarity with the Indian intercity bus, highway hospitality or travel retail landscape.

• Experience piloting new revenue streams or brand partnerships.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

• The opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up environment.

• Real ownership of a programme that directly shapes the passenger experience and revenue across India’s highway corridors.

• Exposure to senior leadership and the chance to pilot and scale new monetisation ideas.

Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? title: Senior Product Manager - Zero-Day Protection
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Austin, TX, London, UK, New York, NY

New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.

As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 25% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.

Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

• Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.

• Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.

• Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.

• Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.

• Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.

• Partner with the Cloudflare Security Analyst team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Analysts provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.

• Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.

• Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.

Customer experience

• Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation

title: Research Engineer, Model Evaluation and Improvement
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re a team focused on making frontier AI models better at science. LLMs know an extraordinary amount of biology, but there’s still a large gap in reasoning for the real-world problems scientists face every day. We recently published some of our work here https://www.benchling.com/blog/can-llms-work-in-the-wet-lab.

You’ll build the datasets, evaluations, and systems that help close that gap. You’ll work with scientists to turn complex scientific work into rigorous tasks that models can learn from and be evaluated against. You’ll partner with leading AI labs to understand where models fail and how to improve them.

This is an early and rapidly evolving area. You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, biology, and frontier AI: finding tasks that are challenging for LLMs and valuable to scientists, designing evaluations that capture real scientific judgment, and building systems to create these tasks at scale.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build datasets for evaluating and improving frontier models, turning complex scientific data into high-quality tasks and environments for LLMs.

- Analyze model failure modes, running experiments across frontier models to understand where they struggle and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Build scalable data infrastructure, creating pipelines that curate, transform, and validate large volumes of scientific data into tasks for model evaluation and improvement.

- Collaborate with frontier AI labs, helping develop and evaluate new approaches for improving models on challenging scientific tasks.

- Work closely with scientists, translating expert judgment into problems and evaluation criteria that can reliably distinguish strong model behavior.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years at the intersection of biology and AI, with academic or industry experience evaluating and improving scientific models or LLMs for biological applications.

- Experience building with LLMs, with an intuition for where current models excel, where they struggle, and how to design systems around their capabilities.

- Curiosity and excitement about frontier AI, with a desire to understand and push the capabilities of rapidly improving models.

- Comfort working on ambiguous problems, where the playing field is rapidly shifting and the right technical approaches are still being discovered.

- Collaborative mindset, able to work closely with engineers, scientists, and external research partners.

- Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift and rapid experimentation is encouraged.

 

HOW WE WORK

We prioritize in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 5 days per week (Monday - Friday).

Our field team's job is to book meetings and work the booth. Your job is to make sure everything around them is booked, shipped, and set up on time and on budget.

What You'll Do

Before each event

• Register the booth and team, and manage exhibitor deadlines, forms, and badge lists

Travel and hospitality

After each event

What We're Looking For

You have 5 to 7 years of experience in event coordination, executive assistance, or both, including trade shows or conferences. Experience with events in public safety, government, or adjacent markets is a plus.

You also bring:

• Experience running several events at once with overlapping deadlines

• Comfort negotiating with vendors and reading contracts

• Experience booking group travel and managing calendars for a busy team

title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform
description:
Job Description Summary
As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform owns the D&S Palantir Foundry environment and leads delivery across the technical teams that build on it and feed it. This person will own platform health, configuration, access and security markings, and ontology development for the D&S Foundry instance and the shared demonstration environment. This person will also be the program owner for 8+ platform functions (data products, platform support, predictive models, emerging technology, user-facing applications, and fleet data), managing the dependencies between them without owning the teams directly. The role also governs Foundry resources, cost, and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) capacity, and owns the platform's access model, including enrollment of external customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role. It turns the D&S data strategy set by the Chief Technology Office (CTO) into a reliable, governed platform that the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) products and our AI roadmap run on. Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities:

Palantir Foundry Platform Ownership

•
Own platform health. Keep the D&S Foundry instance available, performant, and correctly configured, and own the platform roadmap that keeps it that way.

•
Run the demonstration environment. Keep the shared Foundry demo environment current, stable, and ready for customer-facing and leadership demonstrations on short notice.

•
Build the ontology. Drive ontology development in step with front-end work in Workshop and Contour, so the data model and the applications on top of it evolve together.

•
Manage the Palantir roadmap. Serve as the primary vendor contact for licensing, product roadmap, support escalations, and new capability adoption.

Palantir Foundry Resource, Cost, and AIP Management

•
Govern platform resources. Oversee compute allocations, ontology volumes, and storage across every Foundry usage account, and partner with the platform teams to keep resources optimized and fully visible.

•
Own cost attribution. Monitor, analyze, and manage platform consumption and cost down to the usage account, project, and ontology level, with proactive reporting and usage controls (FinOps).

•
Manage AIP capacity. Partner with Palantir to manage AIP utilization, usage thresholds, platform limits, and spend, balancing advanced AI capability against cost containment and operational stability.

• Security, Access Governance, and B2B Enrollment

•
Own the access model. Own the Foundry security posture: design and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC), fine-grained security roles and markings, and scalable access provisioning, so every dataset and application is visible only to the people cleared to see it.

•
Control intangible exports. Define and maintain the strategy for intangible exports (export-controlled technical data shared electronically through the platform) in partnership with Export Compliance.

title: Senior Logic Design Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Logic Design Engineer to join our team full-time in Poland.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Logic Design Engineer to contribute to the development of next-generation FPGA and ASIC-based control platforms.
In this role, you will design and optimize high-performance digital logic with stringent latency and timing requirements. You will work closely with system architects, verification engineers, software developers, and hardware specialists in an international engineering environment.
Our client is an innovative technology company developing advanced control and measurement systems for quantum computing. Its hardware and software platforms enable precise, real-time control of complex quantum systems, supporting the evolution of quantum computing from individual qubits to large-scale architectures.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience

• Solid understanding of digital logic design, computer architecture, and RTL microarchitecture

• Experience with logic synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and timing optimization

• Practical experience with FPGA or ASIC design and implementation workflows

• Understanding of clock-domain crossing (CDC), synchronous digital design, and hardware interfaces

• Experience with simulation-based RTL verification and debugging

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• English proficiency sufficient for effective collaboration within an international engineering team

Desirable:

• Experience with AMD/Xilinx FPGA platforms, particularly AMD Versal

• Experience with ASIC-oriented RTL development and reusable digital IP

• Knowledge of Python, Tcl, or other languages used for development automation

​Position Summary
The Project Controls Director is responsible for establishing, leading, and overseeing the project controls function for large-scale data center construction projects. This role provides strategic leadership for cost control, planning and scheduling, progress measurement, reporting, forecasting, and risk management across the project lifecycle. The Project Controls Director ensures project performance is measured accurately and communicated effectively to executive leadership, clients, and project teams while supporting on-time and on-budget delivery of mission-critical facilities.

Project Controls Leadership

Planning & Scheduling

Helfy is a European leader in digital health, facilitating over 300,000 monthly treatments across the continent through our flagship platform, DoktorABC . We connect licensed physicians, partner pharmacies, and patients to make healthcare faster, discreet, and reliable.
As we expand our footprint in the French market, we are looking for dedicated Independent Endocrinologists to join our medical network. This remote role offers complete autonomy to set your own workload, fitting smoothly alongside an existing practice or hospital appointment while generating a consistent supplemental revenue stream.
Responsibilities
As our Endocrinology Category Lead , you will combine remote clinical consultations with high-impact clinical leadership. You will serve as our primary specialist authority in France, shaping our medical standards, safety frameworks, and treatment protocols in specialized endocrine and metabolic health.

•
100% Remote Opportunity: Lead consultations and protocol development from your home or personal workspace, wherever you are based, provided you hold valid authorization to practice in France.

•
Protocol & Clinical Leadership: Design, refine, and audit clinical guidelines, triage algorithms, contraindication screenings, and dosing escalation protocols for our French medical services.

Targeted Clinical Consultations: Conduct specialized teleconsultations and reviews focused exclusively on three core therapeutic pillars:

•

•
Weight Loss & Obesity Management: Advanced GLP-1 and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist therapies, lifestyle integration, and long-term metabolic monitoring.

•
Type 2 Diabetes: Glycemic control protocols, early-stage interventions, and continuous therapeutic oversight.

•
Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT): Endocrine assessment for hypogonadism, laboratory screening protocols, safety thresholds, and hormone optimization.

•
Maximum Schedule Flexibility: Organize your review hours and protocol advisory workload around your hospital duties or private clinical practice.

Licensing & Credentials: Fully licensed Medical Doctor (MD) registered with the Conseil National de l’Ordre des Médecins (CNOM) with a recognized medical specialization in Endocrinology, Diabetology, and Nutrition (DES d’Endocrinologie-Diabétologie-Nutrition or recognized EU equivalent).

•
Active Registration: Valid and active RPPS number with unrestricted authorization to practice medicine in France.

•
Deep Clinical Expertise: Proven authority and current clinical experience in managing:

•

• In-depth dosing, titration, monitoring, and safety profiles of GLP-1 receptor agonists and anti-obesity medications.

• Evidence-based diagnostic workflows and monitoring for Hypogonadism & Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT) (hematocrit/PSA tracking, fertility considerations, contraindications).

• Comprehensive care pathways for Type 2 Diabetes .

•
Clinical Governance Mindset: Prior experience in writing clinical guidelines, medical review protocols, or leading safety audits is a strong asset.

•
Insurance: Active individual professional indemnity insurance ( Responsabilité Civile Professionnelle - RCP ) covering specialist teleconsultation and medical advisory activities in France.

•
Setup & Security: High-speed internet access, private setup ensuring strict adherence to medical confidentiality, and comfort using modern telehealth interfaces.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.
Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental property management software unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.
About the role
Hostaway is seeking a highly motivated Senior Backend Engineer to join the Core team. This team is responsible for the integrations with our key partners (Online Travel Agencies). These integrations are critical to our customers’ daily workflows, powering seamless connectivity between their properties and major booking platforms. If you’ve worked on similar tools that handle huge volumes and interact with a variety of complex APIs, you’ll be a great fit!
What you'll do

• Design, build, and operate backend services in PHP and Go.

• Drive the extraction of services out of our monolith , defining clean boundaries, ownership, and migration paths.

• Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to shape the technical direction and ensure our backend services deliver maximum value.

• Design and ship APIs built for agentic interfaces - making our guest-facing domain consumable by AI agents and automated workflows.

• Improve page speed and end-to-end performance , working closely with frontend peers since conversion depends on it.

• Contribute to high-level architectural decisions and help us move quickly without accumulating regret.

• Leverage AI to accelerate code delivery - we provide a Claude Team Premium subscription and expect engineers to use it well.

Requirements

• 6+ years of experience as a Backend Engineer, with a strong foundation in software engineering,

• Strong-level proficiency in PHP and/or Golang , with a strong willingness to dive into both.

• Proven experience designing and operating high-traffic, customer-facing systems.

• Experience decomposing monoliths or extracting services, with a pragmatic view on when to do it (and when not to).

• Solid experience designing APIs - REST, GraphQL, or similar - with an eye on clarity, versioning, and consumability (bonus if you've built APIs for AI agents or LLM-driven clients).

• Familiarity with transitioning event-driven service-oriented architectures by applying Domain Driven Design (DDD) principles

• Comfortable using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) as part of your daily workflow, and able to get real leverage out of them.

• Experience working in a Cloud environment (AWS is a plus).

• Experience with message queues (e.g., AWS SQS) is a plus.

What success looks like

• Services are progressively extracted from the monolith with clear ownership and minimal disruption to delivery.

• Performance (page speed, latency, uptime) becomes a measurable strength of the products.

• Our domain is accessible through clean, well-designed APIs that agentic clients can consume reliably.

• The team gets real productivity gains from AI-assisted development , without sacrificing code quality or ownership.

• Cross-functional collaboration with Product and Design runs smoothly, with engineering contributing meaningfully to product direction.

What we offer

• Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.

• 100% Remote: We have no physical offices. Work from your home office, a co-working space, or a dining room table anywhere in your country of residence. Visiting family or travelling? You can work from another country for a temporary stay with your lead’s app

title: Technical Program Manager, Security Assurance
description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Delinea’s Deputy CISO organization is seeking an experienced and highly skilled Technical Program Manager to contribute to the planning, execution, and delivery of Delinea’s Governance, Risk, & Compliance, Internal Assurance, and Offensive Security programs and initiatives.

This role will be responsible for assisting the Deputy CISO in driving execution of multiple initiatives across their organization and plays a critical part in ensuring the timely and effective implementation of GRC, Internal Assurance, and Offensive Security initiatives and aligning efforts with organizational goals.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in governance, risk, compliance, assurance, or offensive security, along with program management, with a proven ability to collaborate with engineering, legal, regulatory, and security leaders and coordinate complex, large-scale initiatives.

This is a hybrid role that is based in Mexico City, Mexico (Tue, Wed, Thu) and reports to the Deputy CISO.

· Help create and evolve metrics to define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs). Create and provide regular reporting to engineering and security leadership, as needed.

· Facilitate operating cadences for the Deputy CISO and direct reports, including planning sessions, status reviews, and steering meetings, capturing decisions, action items, and owners.

· Collaborate with Technical Program Managers across Cybersecurity to capture interdependencies and ensure consistency in planning, tracking, and reporting.

· Coordinate audit and certification readiness activities (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) on behalf of GRC leads, including evidence collection timelines, control owner follow-ups, and auditor scheduling.

· Coordinate logistics for penetration tests, red team exercises, and third-party assessments on behalf of Offensive Security leads, including scheduling, stakeholder communications, and status tracking.

· Maintain Security Assurance program documentation, including roadmaps, processes, runbooks, and status updates.

· 5+ years of experience in Technical Program or Project Management, with at least 2 years supporting governance, risk, compliance, assurance/audit, or offensive security programs.

· Proven experience coordinating large, complex security or technology programs across cross-functional engineering, legal, and compliance teams.

• Responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of fraud risk policies, strategies, rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, and control documentation across onboarding and monitoring workflows.

• Develop data-backed recommendations for auto-approval criteria, manual-review routing, payment holds, restrictions, limit treatments, step-up verification, account monitoring, and escalation thresholds.

• Document strategy rationale, rule logic, data sources, expected impact, monitoring plans, policy considerations, change history, and recommended follow-up actions.

• Design and optimize controls for payment fraud, onboarding risk, account takeover, business email compromise, counterparty fraud, tenant payment fraud, synthetic identity, first-party misuse, bust-out behavior, stolen payment instruments, refund or dispute abuse, and emerging typologies.

Analytics, Data Science & Rule Performance

• Independently source, query, and analyze data using SQL to validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives and false negatives, and evaluate loss exposure, operational impact, and customer friction.

Operational Feedback & Cross-Functional Execution

• Partner with Onboarding Risk Operations and Risk Monitoring Operations to incorporate case outcomes, queue trends, investigator feedback, alert quality, and operational pain points into strategy improvements.

• Review themes from Trust and Safety escalations to identify control gaps, recurring fraud signals, product or process vulnerabilities, or policy needs requiring durable remediation.

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payment Operations, Compliance/AML, Legal, and Operational Excellence on tooling, workflow, data availability, rule implementation, and control monitoring.

• Provide concise updates on fraud trends, strategy performance, emerging risks, rule effectiveness, false positive impact, and recommended actions to fraud leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Share fraud findings

Hi 👋🏻 I’m Louis, Head of Security. You’ll report directly to me.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you contribute to useful projects, make practical decisions, and work in an almost-no-meeting culture. We’re looking for an engineer with a passion to learn whose focus is on building “paved roads” specifically around making secure delivery part of the way we build and ship software. You’ll operate the checks and workflows around our delivery pipeline, help engineers act on useful findings, and make routine exceptions straightforward under agreed policies.

Product Engineering teams own triage and remediation for the features they maintain. Application Security provides specialist analysis and defines product-security test requirements. Infrastructure retains ownership of the underlying cloud platform. You’ll work with those teams to make agreed checks and policies run reliably in the delivery workflow.

- Give engineers self-service exceptions within documented rules, with an owner, justification, expiry, and audit trail. Escalate decisions outside those rules to Security leadership with the relevant specialist analysis.

A technical background and broad knowledge of the AI ecosystem are essential with domain expertise in AI infrastructure a strong plus. SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & EXECUTION

You will develop the strategy, write the content, shape the voice, test formats, track performance, and build a social engine that is sharp, intelligent, and distinctive. You should know how to ask good questions, pressure-test claims, avoid hype and make technical content accessible without making it shallow.

You should be fluent with modern marketing, social, research, writing, analytics, AI, design, video, transcript, and workflow tools. We are looking for someone who uses tools, AI tools in particular, to move faster, test more ideas, repurpose better, and increase output quality without adding process drag.

You should be comfortable measuring what works, identifying patterns, and improving the system over time.

- You are an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment.

- You are social-native, not social-adjacent. You understand hooks, formats, timing, voice, audience behavior, and what makes technical content travel, especially within the AI community.
